
         ent  $

START    im   1
         ei
         call MAKETAB

         ld   a,4
         out  (254),a

         ld   b,10
LOOP0    push bc

         ld   bc,0
LOOP1    push bc
         ld   a,0
         call DRAWRFST
         pop  bc
         inc  b
         ld   a,b
         cp   192
         jr   c,LOOP1

         pop  bc
         djnz LOOP0

         ld   bc,0
LOOP3    push bc
         ld   a,0
         call DRAWRGHT
         pop  bc
         inc  b
         ld   a,b
         cp   192
         jr   c,LOOP3

         ld   bc,0
LOOP4    push bc
         ld   a,192
         call DRAWDOWN
         pop  bc
         inc  c
         jr   nz,LOOP4

STEP     equ  5

         ld   a,0
LOOP     push af
         ld   de,96*256+128
         call CIRCLE
         pop  af
         add  a,STEP
         cp   96
         jr   c,LOOP

         ld   a,0
LOOP2    push af
         ld   de,96*256+128
         call CIRCLE
         pop  af
         add  a,STEP
         cp   96
         jr   c,LOOP2

         call RANDRAW

         ld   a,1
         ld   de,96*256+50
LOOP5    push af
         push de
         call RING
         pop  de
         inc  e
         pop  af
         add  a,1
         cp   96
         jr   c,LOOP5

         dec  e
         ld   a,95
LOOP8    push af
         push de
         call RING
         pop  de
         dec  e
         pop  af
         sub  1
         jr   nc,LOOP8

RANDRAW  ld   bc,0
         ld   (LASTXY+1),bc
         call PLOT3

         ld   bc,191*256+255
         ld   de,257
         call DRAW

         ld   b,20
         ld   hl,0
         ld   (RANDOM+1),hl
LOOP6    push bc
LOOP7    call RANDOM
         ld   a,h
         cp   192
         jr   nc,LOOP7
         ld   b,h
         ld   c,l
         call DRAWTO
         pop  bc
         djnz LOOP6
         ret



DRAWDOWN ld   e,a
         ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/512
         add  hl,hl
         ld   a,(hl)
         inc  l
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,l
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         and  7
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,e
DRAWD2   ld   a,(hl)
         xor  c
         ld   (hl),a
         call DOWNHL
         djnz DRAWD2
         ret

DRAWRGHT ld   e,a
         ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/512
         add  hl,hl
         ld   a,(hl)
         inc  l
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,l
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         and  7
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,e
DRAWR2   ld   a,(hl)
         xor  c
         ld   (hl),a
         rrc  c
         jr   nc,DRAWR3
         inc  l
DRAWR3   djnz DRAWR2
         ret

DRAWRFST ld   d,a
         ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/512
         add  hl,hl
         ld   a,(hl)
         inc  l
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,l
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         or   d
         ld   e,255
         ld   b,32
         jr   z,DRAWRF3
         ld   a,c
         and  7
         add  a,TABLE2-TABLE
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE2/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         ld   e,a

         ld   a,c
         and  7
         add  a,d
         sub  8
         ld   d,a
         jr   c,DRAWRF2

         ld   a,(hl)
         xor  e
         ld   (hl),a
         inc  l

         ld   a,d
         rra
         rra
         rra
         and  31
         ld   e,255
         jr   z,DRAWRF2
         ld   b,a

DRAWRF3  ld   a,(hl)
         xor  e
         ld   (hl),a
         inc  l
         djnz DRAWRF3

DRAWRF2  ld   a,d
         and  7
         ret  z
         add  a,TABLE3-TABLE
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE3/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         and  e
         xor  (hl)
         ld   (hl),a
         ret

DRAWTO   ld   hl,(LASTXY+1)
         ld   de,257
         ld   a,b
         sub  h
         jr   nc,DRAWTO2
         cpl
         inc  a
         ld   d,-1
DRAWTO2  ld   b,a
         ld   a,c
         sub  l
         jr   nc,DRAWTO3
         cpl
         inc  a
         ld   e,-1
DRAWTO3  ld   c,a

DRAW     ld   a,c
         cp   b
         jr   nc,DLXGTY
         ld   l,c
         push de
         xor  a
         ld   e,a
         jr   DLLARGER

DLXGTY   or   c
         ret  z
         ld   l,b
         ld   b,c
         push de
         ld   d,0
DLLARGER ld   h,b
         ld   a,b
         rra
DLLOOP   add  a,l
         jr   c,DLDIAG
         cp   h
         jr   c,DLHRVT
DLDIAG   sub  h
         ld   c,a
         exx
         pop  bc
         push bc
         jr   LASTXY

DLHRVT   ld   c,a
         push de
         exx
         pop  bc
LASTXY   ld   hl,0
         ld   a,b
         add  a,h
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,c
         inc  a
         add  a,l
         jr   c,DLRANGE
         jr   z,DLERR
DLPLOT   dec  a
         ld   c,a
         ld   (LASTXY+1),bc
         call PLOT3
         exx
         ld   a,c
         djnz DLLOOP
         pop  de
         ret

DLRANGE  jr   z,DLPLOT
DLERR    pop  af
         ret


PLOT3    push de
         push hl
         ld   l,b
         ld   h,SCRNADRS/512
         add  hl,hl
         ld   a,(hl)
         inc  l
         ld   h,(hl)
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         rrca
         rrca
         rrca
         and  31
         add  a,l
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,c
         and  7
         ld   c,a
         ld   b,TABLE/256
         ld   a,(bc)
         xor  (hl)
         ld   (hl),a
         pop  hl
         pop  de
         ret

CIRCLE   call SQUAREA
         push hl
         srl  h
         rr   l
         call SQROOT
         ld   a,c
         pop  hl

         push af
         inc  a
         push af
         dec  a

         push hl
         call SQUAREA
         ld   c,l
         ld   b,h
         pop  hl
         or   a
         push hl
         sbc  hl,bc
         call SQROOT
         pop  hl

         pop  bc
         ld   c,b
         sub  c
         dec  a
         jr   nz,CIRCLE0

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         add  a,c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         add  a,c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

CIRCLE0  pop  af

CIRCLE2  push af
         push af
         push hl
         call SQUAREA
         ld   c,l
         ld   b,h
         pop  hl
         or   a
         push hl
         sbc  hl,bc
         call SQROOT
         ld   b,a
         pop  hl
         pop  af
         ld   c,a

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,c
         ex   af,af'
         ld   a,e
         add  a,b
         ld   c,a
         ex   af,af'
         ld   b,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         add  a,c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,c
         ex   af,af'
         ld   a,e
         sub  b
         ld   c,a
         ex   af,af'
         ld   b,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         pop  af
         push af
         or   a
         jr   z,CIRCLE3

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         add  a,c
         ld   c,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  c
         ex   af,af'
         ld   a,e
         add  a,b
         ld   c,a
         ex   af,af'
         ld   b,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         sub  c
         ex   af,af'
         ld   a,e
         sub  b
         ld   c,a
         ex   af,af'
         ld   b,a
         call PLOT3
         pop  bc

CIRCLE3  pop  af
         sub  1
         jp   nc,CIRCLE2
         ret

RING     push af
         call SQUAREA
         pop  af

RING2    push hl
         push af
         push af
         push hl
         call SQUAREA
         ld   c,l
         ld   b,h
         pop  hl
         or   a
         push hl
         sbc  hl,bc
         call SQROOT
         ld   c,a
         pop  hl
         pop  af
         ld   b,a

         push bc
         ld   a,c
         add  a,a
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,d
         sub  b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         push de
         ld   a,l
         push hl
         call DRAWRFST
         pop  hl
         pop  de
         pop  bc

         pop  af
         push af
         or   a
         jr   z,RING3

         push bc
         ld   a,d
         add  a,b
         ld   b,a
         ld   a,e
         sub  c
         ld   c,a
         push de
         ld   a,l
         call DRAWRFST
         pop  de
         pop  bc

RING3    pop  af
         pop  hl
         sub  1
         jp   nc,RING2
         ret


SQROOT   xor  a
         push de
         push hl
SQR2     ld   de,64
         ld   a,l
         ld   l,h
         ld   h,d
         ld   b,8
SQR4     sbc  hl,de
         jr   nc,SQR3
         add  hl,de
SQR3     ccf
         rl   d
         add  a,a
         adc  hl,hl
         add  a,a
         adc  hl,hl
         djnz SQR4
         xor  a
         sub  h
         ld   a,0
         adc  a,d
         ld   c,d
         pop  hl
         pop  de
         ret

SQUAREA  ld   b,8
         push de
         ld   hl,0
         ld   d,l
         ld   e,a
SQ2      add  hl,hl
         rla
         jr   nc,SQ3
         add  hl,de
SQ3      djnz SQ2
         pop  de
         ret

MAKETAB  ld   b,192
         ld   de,16384
         ld   hl,SCRNADRS
MAKETAB2 ld   (hl),e
         inc  hl
         ld   (hl),d
         inc  hl
         ex   de,hl
         call DOWNHL
         ex   de,hl
         djnz MAKETAB2
         ret

RANDOM   ld   de,0
         ld   h,e
         ld   l,253
         ld   a,d
         or   a
         sbc  hl,de
         sbc  a,0
         sbc  hl,de
         sbc  a,0
         ld   e,a
         ld   d,0
         sbc  hl,de
         jr   nc,AB
         inc  hl
AB       ld   (RANDOM+1),hl
         ret

UPHL     ld   a,h
         dec  h
         and  7
         ret  nz
         ld   a,l
         sub  32
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         jr   c,UPHL2
         add  a,8
         ld   h,a
UPHL2    cp   64
         ret  nc
         ld   h,87
         ret


DOWNHL   inc  h
         ld   a,h
         and  7
         ret  nz
         ld   a,l
         add  a,32
         ld   l,a
         ld   a,h
         jr   c,DOWNHL2
         sub  8
         ld   h,a
DOWNHL2  cp   88
         ret  c
         ld   h,64
         ret
LAST
A0LEN    equ  $-START

         org  LAST/512+1*512

SCRNADRS defs 512

TABLE    defb 128,64,32,16
         defb 8,4,2,1

TABLE2   defb %11111111
         defb %01111111
         defb %00111111
         defb %00011111
         defb %00001111
         defb %00000111
         defb %00000011
         defb %00000001

TABLE3   defb %00000000
         defb %10000000
         defb %11000000
         defb %11100000
         defb %11110000
         defb %11111000
         defb %11111100
         defb %11111110
